correctness.rationale: The pinned RESULT.md treats 0 by pair-sum pigeonhole for m>=8. For a nonzero missing g, full/single/empty fibers of V/<g> satisfy 2f+s=m and z=f; f=0 forces vanishing second differences of a transversal graph and hence an affine hyperplane. If f>0, a sum-free set around a full fiber forces f>=m/2-1; a four-vertex zero-sum collision rules out f=m/2-1 and, for m>=16, f=m/2. At m=8 remaining occupied quotient four-set must be affinely independent, giving exactly 15*56=840 exceptions with one omitted g. Hyperplane direction four-sums are full for direction dimension>=3. Independently enumerated all 12870 eight-sets: covering 12000, missing-one 840, missing-eight 30, 56 exceptions for each nonzero g. No finite r=5 sampling substitutes for the all-rank proof. Domain r>=4, four distinct summands, exactly half density.
